question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
-- The NXT Championship has the shortest match at 00:43
-- The two wrestlers are Bron Breakker (winner) and Duke Hudson (loser)
-- Let me verify this is the correct answer by checking the unique wrestler names
SELECT DISTINCT w1.name as winner_name, w2.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id
WHERE m.title_id = '23153' AND m.title_change = 0 AND m.duration != '' AND m.duration IS NOT NULL
  AND m.duration = '00:43';
